whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Bell Pepper Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant is well-located at Windsor Hotel on Exhibition Road in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and food menus.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, full food menu, aur customer reviews integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/bellpepper

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Bell Pepper Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table reservation and mobile menu showcase for your location on Exhibition Road. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact menu items, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
